visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two hands hold up two different types of large naan bread—one plain and one yellow with seasoning—over a set table. (2) Close-up of hands stretching and folding dough on a floured countertop in a professional kitchen setting. (3) A hand presses flattened dough against the inside wall of a hot, cylindrical tandoor oven. (4) Spices are poured from a spoon into a pan with sautéed onions and green peppers over high heat. (5) Three metallic bowls of different curries are arranged on a white tablecloth. (6) A spoon lifts a piece of thick beef from a reddish curry garnished with sliced peppers. (7) Yellow rice with peas is plated, and curry sauce with meat is poured over it. (8) A spoon scoops up vibrant green spinach curry from a stainless steel bowl. (9) A torn piece of naan is dipped into the green curry. (10) A close-up of a creamy yellow curry with a red chili garnish. (11) A long, rolled crispy dosa is served on a tray with three small dipping bowls. (12) Batter is spread in a circular motion on a large flat griddle. (13) Pieces of crepe-like bread are dipped into various small bowls of sauces and fillings. (14) Hands pull apart a stuffed dosa to reveal yellow potato filling. (15) Tearing a yellow flatbread covered in black sesame seeds. (16) A large, spiral-patterned spiced flatbread is lifted from a basket. (17) Skewered green and red marinated meats are prepared and pulled from the oven. (18) A platter of grilled prawns is garnished with fresh onions and bell peppers. (19) A platter of green-marinated chicken chunks is displayed. (20) View of a dining room with ornate murals depicting Indian architecture on the walls and red chairs. (21) Exterior shot of a restaurant storefront with a blue and white striped awning and a large sign.
